constructions.title: Annual discharge figures, each counted once

counts.annual_flow_m3_per_year_distinct.is: The sum of the annual discharge or pumped volumes the plan's project pages state, each distinct figure once: a volume stated for the same named structures on two pages counts once.

counts.annual_flow_pages.is: Plan project pages that state an annual discharge or pumped volume.

counts.annual_flow_figures_distinct.is: Distinct annual-volume figures among those pages: one per value and set of structure codes named in its sentence, or one per page where the sentence names no structure.

constructions.what: Adds the annual discharge volumes the statutory plan states, counting a figure stated on more than one page once.
constructions.model: Each page's largest annual figure is keyed by its value and the structure codes (`U4` and the like) its sentence names; the first page with a key contributes it, later pages with the same key are listed as duplicates and left out. A figure whose sentence names no structure is keyed by its page.
assumptions: The same value stated for the same named structures describes one outfall.
A figure whose sentence names no structure code is a figure of its own page.

justified.text: The two Strandvænget pages state the same annual volume for the same overflow structure in near-identical sentences - one is the project, the other the requirement it answers.
The duplicates are named on the page, so the rule is visible where it is applied.

gaps: Two genuinely different outfalls stating the same volume with the same structure codes would be merged; nothing but the codes distinguishes them.
A figure restated without any structure code on two pages is still counted twice.
void_if: the plan pages name structures inconsistently, so one outfall carries different codes on different pages
constructions.licenses: The total annual discharge the plan states, without a figure counted twice for one outfall.
constructions.not_licensed: The volume actually discharged, which is modelled or estimated in the plan, not measured here.
